summary: Retain host names in Core pool membership so a replacement Controller can display an offline member without inventing enrollment or linking to a missing Host panel. API impact: changed contract (additive optional peer join and membership hostname). Native adoption and browser row review passed. Later (2026-09-29, no-legacy decision) the older-member backfill and Controller name handshake were deleted and join requires a hostname.

guide.reason: Join guidance explains how a rebuilt Controller shows Core-named offline members, leaves their Hosts link unavailable until enrollment and displays a stable ID for legacy records without a saved name.

api.reason: Core peer join requires a validated hostname; Core membership reports and signed replicas carry it, and Controller inventory always includes it. The earlier optional-name backfill (advertise hostname, membership_hostname_version, pool-membership-hostname-v1 acknowledgement) was deleted under the 2026-09-29 no-legacy decision. Exact issued join replay remains valid.

roadmap.reason: Corrects the replacement adoption behavior already required by the recovery and destination acceptance gates.

state.record: PoolMember.hostname in the pool master durable peer membership, included in its signed authority replica. A fresh Controller reads it from authenticated Core inventory or an enrolled member reported copy when the master is absent.
state.reason: The host reports its name at pool creation or join; Controller stores no unique pool member name.

verification.method: Focused Core join/replay, legacy backfill, old/offline peer and Controller preflight Go tests; replacement Controller projection Go test; UI rendering test; API contract test; generated reference, documentation and privacy gates. Independent read-only source review found two compatibility gaps and a replay-order defect; corrected paths were re-reviewed with no further material finding. In a new disposable pool, current-source installed Core saved both names in master membership and signed member replica; a fresh Controller with a new CA/database enrolled only the live master and showed the offline member by Core name with unknown connection and no Hosts row. A live headless browser pass showed the named offline member with Unknown connection and no Hosts link; loaded, empty, keyboard and confirmation states passed. API error/empty states were browser mocks. All fixture processes stopped.
verification.limits: Forge CI remains open. Browser API error and empty states were mocked, not a real outage.
